app.name: Splitwatch
app.tagline: Watch several live sports streams side by side.

add.label: YouTube link or video ID
add.placeholder: Paste a YouTube link or video ID
add.invalid: That is not a YouTube video link or ID.
add.duplicate: This stream is already in the grid.
add.full: The grid is full: nine streams at most.

playAll.title: {count, plural, one {Start the stream that is waiting} other {Start the # streams that are waiting}}

empty.title: Add your first stream
empty.body: Paste a YouTube link or video ID in the box at the top. Each stream gets its own lane, and the one you pick is the one you hear.

clipboard.prompt: Add the YouTube video from your clipboard?

ended.prompt: Stream {index} has ended. Live now in {sport}:

layout.label: Layout
layout.featured: One large with a side strip

layouts.title: Saved layouts
layouts.namePlaceholder: A name, such as Saturday finals
layouts.empty: Add a stream first: an empty grid cannot be saved.
layouts.full: There are {max} saved layouts, the most there can be. Delete one first.
layouts.renameTaken: Another layout already has this name.
layouts.copyGrid: Copy a link to this grid
layouts.copied: Link copied. Anyone with Splitwatch can open it.

shared.title: A shared layout
shared.note: Opening it replaces the streams in your grid. Saving it keeps it in your layouts.
shared.full: There are 20 saved layouts, the most there can be.

tile.label: Stream {index}: {title}
tile.listening: Stream {index} is the one you hear
tile.mini: Watch stream {index} in the mini player
tile.popout: Open stream {index} in its own window

popout.away: Stream {index} is in its own window
popout.soundOn: You hear this stream; give the sound back to the grid

sync.title: Line up the streams
sync.intro: Hold back the streams that run ahead until all of them show the same moment. A stream goes back only as far as YouTube lets it be rewound.
sync.later: Hold stream {index} back {seconds, plural, one {# more second} other {# more seconds}}
sync.sooner: Hold stream {index} back {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} less
sync.resetLabel: Take away the delay of stream {index}

error.embedDisabled: The owner does not allow this video to be played outside YouTube.
error.notFound: This video is unavailable: it was removed or made private.
error.invalid: YouTube did not accept this video ID.
error.playback: The player could not play this video.
error.identification: YouTube refused the app's identification (error 153). Please report this.
error.offline: The YouTube player could not load. Check the internet connection.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.escape: Leave the large view, fullscreen or the mini player

actions.playPause: Play or pause the picked stream
actions.miniPlayer: Mini player: the picked stream in a small window on top

settings.title: Settings
settings.savedNote: Changes are saved as soon as you make them.
settings.mediaKeysNote: Play or pause the picked stream and pick the next or previous one, also while another app is in front. Meanwhile, other apps such as music players cannot use these keys.
settings.mediaKeysAccessibility: macOS needs your approval: System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, then turn on Splitwatch.
settings.mediaKeysTaken: Another app holds the media keys; close it, then turn this off and on again.
settings.clipboard: Offer to add YouTube links I copy
settings.keyIntro: Splitwatch works without a key. Your own free key turns on search and shows which streams are live. It is kept encrypted by your system and only sent to YouTube.
settings.keyUnsaved: Save the API key you typed?

keyState.unavailable: This system offers no secure place for the key, so Splitwatch cannot keep one.

keyFailed.invalid-key: YouTube refused this key. Copy it again from the Google Cloud Console.
keyFailed.api-disabled: Turn on the YouTube Data API v3 for the key's project, then try again.
keyFailed.quota: The key's project has no quota left today.
keyFailed.network: YouTube could not be reached. Check the internet connection.
keyFailed.unavailable: This system offers no secure place for the key.
keyFailed.error: The key could not be checked. Try again later.

settings.guideTitle: How to get a free key
settings.guide1: Open the Google Cloud Console and sign in with a Google account.
settings.guide2: Create a project (any name), then open APIs and Services, Library.
settings.guide3: Find YouTube Data API v3 and click Enable.
settings.guide4: Open Credentials, choose Create credentials, API key, and copy the key.
settings.guide5: Optional but wise: edit the key and restrict it to the YouTube Data API v3.
settings.quotaResets: Resets at {time, time, short} (midnight Pacific Time).
settings.animateNote: Only while they show: on the start screen and in empty places of the grid.
settings.performanceNote: Simpler, still backgrounds and no transitions, for slower computers.
settings.spoilers: Spoiler protection: blur titles and thumbnails until I point at them
settings.spoilersNote: Notifications and the tray leave titles out too. YouTube's own player can still show a title over the video.
settings.background: Keep Splitwatch in the {platform, select, darwin {menu bar} other {notification area}} when its window closes
settings.backgroundNote: The streams stop with the window. Splitwatch keeps an eye on what is live, and its icon opens the window again.
settings.startAtLogin: Start Splitwatch when I sign in
settings.startHidden: Start in the {platform, select, darwin {menu bar} other {notification area}}, without a window
settings.startUnavailable: Starting with the system works in the installed app.
settings.startApproval: macOS asks for your approval: System Settings, General, Login Items.
settings.notifyOn: Tell me when a stream goes live
settings.notifyNeedsKey: This needs your YouTube API key: without one, Splitwatch cannot tell whether a stream is live.
settings.notifyNote: Splitwatch looks every ten minutes while it runs, also from the {platform, select, darwin {menu bar} other {notification area}}, and uses a few units of your daily quota.
settings.notifyNoChannels: None yet. Follow a channel with the bell on one of its streams.
settings.notifyFailed: The system did not show the test notification. Check that notifications are allowed for Splitwatch.
settings.themeExported: Saved the theme to a file.
settings.themeInvalid: That file is not a Splitwatch theme.
settings.themeContrast: That theme's text would be hard to read, so it was not added.
settings.themeFull: There are {max} themes of your own, the most there can be. Delete one first.
settings.historyKeep: Keep a watch history on this computer
settings.historyNote: It stays on this computer. Titles and channels go after 30 days; the time by sport stays until you clear it.
settings.soundsNote: Soft sounds in the theme's style when a stream comes or goes, the layout changes or a reminded stream is about to start.
settings.languageUnreviewed: This translation has not been checked by a native speaker yet. Corrections are welcome on GitHub.

tray.liveNone: Nothing is live on your channels right now
tray.liveNeedsKey: Add your YouTube API key in Settings to see what is live

notify.title: {channel} is live
notify.testBody: Splitwatch will tell you when a stream goes live on the channels you picked.

event.title: {name} {year}
event.chipBefore: {name}: {days, plural, one {opens tomorrow} other {opens in # days}}
event.before: {days, plural, one {Opens tomorrow.} other {Opens in # days.}}
event.suggest: The {name} are coming up. Their mode gives Splitwatch their colors and light, a day-by-day schedule and the medal table.
event.scheduleNone: The day-by-day schedule appears here once the organizers publish it.
event.scheduleSource: Days and medal events from the organizers' schedule, through Wikipedia. Times can still change.
event.medalEvents: {count, plural, one {# medal event} other {# medal events}}
event.finalsNone: No final of this day is live on the preset channels right now; search for a sport's live streams instead.
event.medalsNone: The medal table appears here once its Wikipedia page exists.
event.medalsError: The medal table could not be read. Try again later.
event.medalsSource: From English Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0), written by volunteers: it can lag behind or contain mistakes.

search.title: Find a stream
search.label: Search, or paste a YouTube link
search.placeholder: Search live streams, or paste a link
search.cost: Uses 1 of your {limit} daily searches ({left} left).
search.noKey: Searching YouTube needs your own free API key.
search.noSearchesLeft: No searches left today. They come back at {time, time, short}.

failed.invalid-key: YouTube refused the API key. Check it in Settings.
failed.api-disabled: The YouTube Data API is not turned on for this key's project.
failed.quota: Today's quota is used up. It comes back at {time, time, short}.
failed.network: YouTube could not be reached. Check the internet connection.
failed.no-key: Searching YouTube needs your own free API key.
failed.error: The search did not work. Try again later.

live.title: Live now
live.latestNote: With your own YouTube API key, this shows what is live right now.
live.none: Nothing is live on the preset channels right now.

upcoming.title: The coming week
upcoming.noReminders: No reminders yet. Splitwatch tells you when a stream you pick starts, while it runs.
upcoming.needsKey: With your own YouTube API key, this lists the coming week's streams on the channels of your sports.
upcoming.none: Nothing is scheduled on the channels of your sports for the coming week.

history.title: Your watching
history.note: Kept on this computer only. Titles and channels go 30 days after you last watched, as YouTube asks; the time by sport stays until you clear it.
history.off: The watch history is off, so nothing new is added. Settings can turn it on.
history.empty: Nothing watched yet. Time counts while streams play on screen.
history.clearAsk: Clear the whole watch history, and the streams kept for search suggestions?

ambient.title: Waiting screen
ambient.none: Nothing coming up yet. Reminders and the coming streams on your sports appear here.

follows.open: Follow channels from your YouTube subscriptions…
follows.how: In Google Takeout, export only YouTube subscriptions, then pick subscriptions.csv from the download.
follows.invalid: That file holds no YouTube channels. Pick subscriptions.csv from a Google Takeout export.
follows.title: Follow channels from your subscriptions
follows.intro: {total, plural, one {# channel} other {# channels}} in the file. Up to {max} channels can be followed in all.

themeEditor.note: While you edit, the whole app wears the theme.
themeEditor.name: Name
themeEditor.ok: All text is easy to read, in light and in dark mode.
themeEditor.ask: Save the changes to this theme?
themeEditor.askBlocked: This theme cannot be saved while some text is hard to read. Leave without saving?

sport.title: Sport of stream {index}
sport.note: The sport gives the stream its color, and when all streams share one, the whole window takes its theme.
